entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Investigating Officer Dharmendra Shivhare, SHO PS Bairad District Shivpuri appeared in person.
His further appearance before the court is hereby dispensed with.

The writ court vide order dated 09.09.2020 in W.P.No.13163 of 2020 has directed as under :
"Investigating AGency PS Bairad, district Shivpuri is directed to conclude the investigation triggered by the FIR bearing Crime No.346/2019 dated 17.12.2019 alleging offences punishable under SEctions 420, 467, 468, 471 and 34 of IPC, as expeditiously as possible.
S.P. Shivpuri is directed to ensure that the investigating is completed in a fair and impartial manner at the earliest".

A status report has been filed by the respondents in compliance of the order dated 09.09.2020 and after completion of the investigation, a Closure report has been submitted before JMFC, Pohri District Shivpuri stating that no offence is made out against concerned accused persons.
From a perusal of the order passed by the writ court and status report, 2 CONC-2559-2024 it appears that the order passed by the writ court has been substantially complied with.

Although the petitioner is not satisfied with the closure report, but this court while hearing the contempt petition,
cannot go beyond the order passed by the writ court.

If the petitioner is still aggrieved by the order Ghanshyam Singh Dhakad vs Shri Sanjay Dubey on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156783757/
1 passed by the respondents, he is free to challenge the same before the appropriate forum in accordance with law.
